ledger.x: 1920: the Persian Socialist Soviet Republic is proclaimed at Rasht.

1920: Gilan passes from the Qajar government to the republic of Mirza Kuchik Khan, supported by the Soviet Caspian Fleet that entered Anzali in May 1920 while the British garrison 'evacuated the town without any resistance'.
1921: the Soviet Republic of Gilan ends in September 1921 and Gilan returns to the Persian government.

wars.name: Soviet intervention in Gilan
wars.outcome: The Jangali republic held Gilan from May 1920; after the Soviet-Persian treaty of February 1921 and Reza Khan's coup it collapsed in September 1921.

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier of the republic, only Gilan; drawn soft.
